claim_text: It will be a shock and awe to the world, even more than the Venezuela operation, and it happened two at the same time, with the flex coming while everyone is distracted.
quote: IT HAPPENED AT THE TWO TWO AT THE SAME TIME
falsify_match: Two major simultaneous operations.
falsify_miss: A single one, or none. This is the earliest telling of the two at once.

claim_text: Wisdom on Cuba, Mexico, Venezuela and Colombia, leadership rising in Brazil and a major harvest of souls throughout South America, with prayer over South Korea, Taiwan, Japan, North Korea, the Philippines, all the islands and Australia.
quote: a MAJOR HARVEST OF SOULS IS COMING ALL THROUGHOUT SOUTH AMERICA
falsify_match: Measurable church growth across South America.
falsify_miss: None. Latin American Protestant growth has been high for decades, which is the base rate.

claim_text: There will be fearful sights, but a glorious church rises in America with great glory, days of fun that have just begun, and churches with heaven on earth and the glory manifested in services.
quote: Days of fun, days of fun have just begun
falsify_match: A visible phenomenon in American services.
falsify_miss: None. Heaven on earth is not defined against anything measurable.

claim_text: A major move of God in churches across America and specifically at a named pastor's church again, which he expects to see on the streamed services and says he will drive down and camp in the parking lot for.
quote: I saw uh uh John Kilpatrick's church again
falsify_match: Sustained revival meetings at that named church.
falsify_miss: None. He names the church repeatedly, which makes this one of the more checkable revival claims.

claim_text: A big red light in the sky the night before that went all across America and Asia, which he says is a sign to observe, the blood red moon, meaning Jesus is coming.
quote: That's why that big red light was in the sky last night
falsify_match: Nothing beyond the eclipse itself, which is astronomical.
falsify_miss: Nothing. The lunar eclipse was scheduled and published years in advance.

claim_text: The angels of the Lord make war against the demonic principalities holding them back, with the greatest outpouring flowing over North Korea and the underground church of China rising up with the dead raised and amazing miracles, and shock and awe on the television.
quote: the underground church of China. the underground church
falsify_match: Open Chinese church growth with documented healings.
falsify_miss: None. Shock and awe on the television is the only part that would be visible.

claim_text: He says he has been doing videos back to back, that there is a lot of work to do and many hands make light work, and that he feels great victory and believes what happened in Texas today will not happen.
quote: I feel in my spirit we have great victory
falsify_match: Nothing. An opening remark.
falsify_miss: Nothing. He does not say what happened in Texas.

claim_text: What they had was not going to be found by American troops or strikes because they hid it deeper in the earth, in what looked like a railroad under the soil of Iran with huge caverns and train cars, moving military equipment from vulnerable places to secure ones closer to the strait.
quote: Like a railroad under the earth underneath the soil of Iran
falsify_match: An underground rail network found moving Iranian materiel.
falsify_miss: None found. Saying it will not be found removes the test in advance.

claim_text: A glory dome around them by the hand of God, and China having a coup in its camp among the military and around its leader with so much confusion that they turn on themselves, while the North Korean leader grows paranoid seeing what happened in Venezuela and wondering who is next.
quote: there'll be so much confusion that they'll turn on themselves
falsify_match: A coup attempt or purge in the Chinese military.
falsify_miss: None. A coup in Beijing would be unmistakable if it happened.

claim_text: He believes Cuba will be next after all this and asks how fast it will end, and prays divine protection over the troops, noting opinion is split across social media.
quote: I truly believe it's Cuba that's next
falsify_match: American action against Cuba following Iran.
falsify_miss: None. He marks it as his own belief rather than a word here.

claim_text: He works out on air which night the total lunar eclipse and blood moon falls on, settling on the following night, with the main totality from the West Coast and over Hawaii.
quote: The total lunar eclipse and blood moon will be visible
falsify_match: The eclipse occurs as published.
falsify_miss: Nothing of his own. Eclipse timing is calculated years in advance.

claim_text: The blood moon represents war and is seen over Asia and Hawaii rather than over Iran, which gives him great caution over Hawaii, Asia and Australia because of the conflict he saw starting there involving Australia, South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, China and North Korea.
quote: represents war
falsify_match: A conflict opening in the Pacific after this eclipse.
falsify_miss: None. The eclipse path is astronomical fact; the meaning and the placing are his.

claim_text: While America is preoccupied with Iran he saw China rise to take Taiwan, and asks whether the blood moon falling over that area is coincidence or symbolic, calling for Taiwan and South Korea to be covered more in prayer because China is upset over losing its Venezuelan and Iranian oil.
quote: I saw China raise up try to take Taiwan
falsify_match: A Chinese move on Taiwan while America is engaged with Iran.
falsify_miss: None. The oil motive is the mechanism, and it is checkable against Chinese import data.

claim_text: China was buying oil at about twenty five dollars a barrel from Venezuela and Iran and both sources are now under attack, so he asks whether China will sit idly by over Taiwan, and prays for a coup and confusion in their camp.
quote: I think it was $25 a barrel or whatever it was
falsify_match: Chinese action over the loss of those supplies.
falsify_miss: None. The barrel price is repeated from what his son showed him rather than checked.

claim_text: Confusion for the sake of Taiwan so that they do not become communist and China does not interfere with South Korea or Japan, with the Chinese turning on themselves as the army did in the Gideon account.
quote: That they will not become communist
falsify_match: Taiwan staying free and Chinese forces in disarray.
falsify_miss: China takes it. He prays against the outcome he says he was shown, as he does throughout.

claim_text: An attack on American soil, a Red Dawn experience from the secret cells that the FBI and Homeland Security do not know about, who got in under the previous administration, though he believes prayer will cause them to make great mistakes and be found.
quote: a Red Dawn experience. From the the the cells, the secret cells
falsify_match: An armed attack inside America by an organised foreign network.
falsify_miss: None. Red Dawn is a film reference, and the standard he sets is an invasion rather than a plot.

claim_text: He believes for great mistakes in their plots, especially over the mall in Hawaii where he saw three men, near the statue of the man with flowers on his neck and a surfboard, across from the designer shops.
quote: The three the three men I saw in Hawaii in that mall area
falsify_match: An attack or foiled plot at that mall.
falsify_miss: None. The statue and the shops place this precisely enough to fail cleanly.

claim_text: A mass event taking place in that circle, which he first saw at Christmas, chosen to show they have infiltrated every area of the nation, using a van as a weapon against people, and the same seen on the Las Vegas strip by the named hotels and casino.
quote: it was a van to use it as a weapon against the people
falsify_match: A vehicle attack at either location.
falsify_miss: None. Vehicle ramming attacks are a known method, which is the base rate to weigh it against.

claim_text: Divine protection over the president's family, the vice president and the cabinet, and he believes the last forty eight hours were God liberating the people of Iran, who have been given a window of opportunity for a major revival that does not last very long.
quote: I will give the people of Iran a window of opportunity
falsify_match: A brief opening for the church in Iran.
falsify_miss: No opening. The window is never given a length, so it cannot expire.

claim_text: A door is huge and a window is small, and the same short window is given to North Korea, but for Cuba and Mexico he did not see a window but a whole lifestyle change forever, a major door, with green around Cuba and a spring of growth and an extension cord running underground from Cuba to Russia.
quote: I saw it as a whole a whole lifestyle change forever
falsify_match: A short Iranian opening and a permanent Cuban and Mexican change.
falsify_miss: Neither. The distinction between window and door is the most useful thing he has said about scoring these.

claim_text: Cuba becomes powered with electricity that looks like internet and wealth growth, with a spring of growth out of the land, which the Lord says is first the blade, then the ear, then the full corn, a new way of life rather than a passing revival, with the Secretary of State having a big hand in it.
quote: It's just the blade. First the blade, then the ear
falsify_match: A lasting economic and religious change in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. The blade, ear and corn framing means an early absence is expected.

claim_text: Every plot in every major influencing city brought to nothing, even over Hawaii and the malls where people gather to shop, and the ships in the Mediterranean and the strait protected from any drone attack or missile bombardment.
quote: Even over Hawaii. Around our malls
falsify_match: An attack at a mall or on an American ship.
falsify_miss: None. The prayer framing means an absence is read as the answer.

claim_text: He is making moves soon and is upset, talking to Russia, and he sees Putin and the man over Turkey talking.
quote: I see Putin and the man over Turkey talking
falsify_match: A Russia and Turkey alignment over Iran.
falsify_miss: None. The two leaders have met regularly for years, which is the base rate.

claim_text: He sees the opening where the boats come in and go and Turkey trying to control that passage almost like Panama, flexing about war, beating his drums and becoming a tyrant in the days ahead concerning the ships and boats, with Russia and him becoming closer friends.
quote: I SEE THIS MAN BECOME TYRANT CONCERNING THE SHIPS
falsify_match: Turkey controlling passage through the straits beyond the Montreux terms.
falsify_miss: It does not. The Panama comparison is the clearest statement of what he means by control.

claim_text: They beat their drums, angry about what is going on with Iran, wanting to come against America in a greater way, and he is looking right now for strategic allies, with the whirlwind turning and the name Napoleon spoken.
quote: AND HE'S LOOKING RIGHT NOW FOR STRATEGIC ALLIES
falsify_match: A new alliance formed against America over Iran.
falsify_miss: None forms. Napoleon is spoken without explanation.

claim_text: He wants more and wants it seen, and this will be the beginning of a greater war in Ukraine and the taking out of the Ukrainian president, with no more cat and mouse play and the heavy artillery brought out today.
quote: NO MORE CAT AND MOUSE PLAY
falsify_match: A Russian escalation in Ukraine and the killing of its president.
falsify_miss: Neither. Today is the tightest timing he has attached to the Zelensky claim.

claim_text: If they control the passage for the ships to come in and out they block the flow, take over Ukraine and dictate that part of the world, and then he sees France.
quote: CONCERNING TO BLOCK THE FLOW
falsify_match: Turkey closing the straits and Russia taking Ukraine.
falsify_miss: Neither. Blocking the flow is the mechanism he gives for how Ukraine falls.

claim_text: He says he sees Taiwan and he sees China.
quote: I see Taiwan. I see Taiwan. I SEE CHINA
falsify_match: Nothing on its own.
falsify_miss: Nothing. Two names with nothing attached.

claim_text: It is something about the water and controlling it, and he asks his son on air whether they have their own canal and whether the boats come up past Turkey, saying everything he sees is the boats coming through there with Turkey trying to control the area.
quote: IT'S SOMETHING ABOUT THE WATER, controlling it
falsify_match: Turkey restricting the straits.
falsify_miss: It does not. He works the geography out on air, asking whether that is the only waterway to the Black Sea.

claim_text: Europe will be waking and Europe will be shaken, with a great war.
quote: Europe will be waking. Europe will be shaken
falsify_match: A war in Europe followed by religious revival there.
falsify_miss: Neither. Shaken is not defined against anything measurable.

claim_text: It will be about the supply chains and getting shipments, bringing down the walls of trade between Canada and the United States to make them one, with the scorpion king seen and a shaking in the royal family that he says he warns of again.
quote: I shaking in the royal family. I warn you again
falsify_match: A crisis in the British royal family, or a customs union with Canada.
falsify_miss: Neither. Two separate claims are packed into one passage.

claim_text: He is in New York in the spirit looking at a big building he keeps being shown and praying over it, an all glass front building with no stone.
quote: It's an all glass front building. No stone
falsify_match: An attack on a glass-fronted New York tower.
falsify_miss: None. Glass-fronted towers are the norm in Manhattan, which weakens the identification.

claim_text: The Lord says he is bringing all that trash down because it divides families, and tells him to go through New York and these cities and call revival, which he says he is doing as he goes.
quote: GO THROUGH THE CITIES. GO THROUGH THESE PLACES AND CALL REVIVAL
falsify_match: Revival in the named cities.
falsify_miss: None. What is being brought down is described only as trash and division.

claim_text: He goes into America and Europe in the same flow, and says anyone who wants to keep camping where they are will miss the greatest move of God they could have seen, with all nine thousand one hundred watching praying into it.
quote: you're going to miss out on the greatest move of God
falsify_match: A visible move across both regions.
falsify_miss: None. Conditioning it on the audience means an absence is their failure rather than the word's.

claim_text: Rockets fired by Hezbollah being taken down with laser weapons, which he ties to going in the spirit three or four nights earlier about Israel's weapons and seeing things he says would make the hair stand up on your arms, wondering whether they will use them.
quote: They're using laser weapons, Star Wars. I told you
falsify_match: The earlier recordings describe a laser system before this footage.
falsify_miss: They do not. Israel's laser air defence programme has been publicly reported since 2022.

claim_text: He says he saw the man being taken out while he was leading and talking to a crowd, and returns to Turkey and the strait, asking his son whether that is the only waterway leading to the Black Sea.
quote: But he was leading. He was talking to a crowd
falsify_match: That man killed while addressing a crowd.
falsify_miss: He is not. Speaking to a crowd is the setting he gives across the tellings.

claim_text: He says the Lord told him to remind them not to pray the news, because anyone praying the news is behind, and that everything they have seen over the last year and a half led to this point, having prayed for weeks about the drones, the missile attacks, Tel Aviv and Taiwan.
quote: Remind them don't pray the news
falsify_match: The recordings consistently precede the events.
falsify_miss: They do not. This is the earliest statement of the standard he sets himself.

claim_text: They pray into the future rather than the past or present and will not camp around what the news says, and he rejoices that an evil man is no longer in power, saying he either found Jesus in the last seconds or is in hell.
quote: We don't pray into the past and the present
falsify_match: The recordings show forward rather than reactive prayer.
falsify_miss: They do not. Much of each broadcast is spent reading the day's news back as confirmation.

claim_text: Before the attack the Lord said he wanted to bring a great revival to the people of Iran and that there would be a regime change, with shakings in Iran, Pakistan, Afghanistan and all the Arab nations, and that he is waiting on them to bring in the harvest.
quote: There'll be a shaking in uh Pakistan. There's going to be this in Afghanistan
falsify_match: Upheaval across those three countries.
falsify_miss: None. Shaking is undefined, so unrest of any size in any of them would be claimed.

claim_text: A superhighway above them with translations, so those walking with the Father will be here and then there ministering to people, through a door long closed that is about to open and flood wide the gates, with one of the greatest harvests through South America, Cuba, Venezuela and Colombia.
quote: the super highway above us with with translations
falsify_match: A demonstrated case of bodily translation.
falsify_miss: None. It is conditioned on walking with the Father, which explains any absence.

claim_text: A major harvest through Brazil, and after this is over Cuba is next and could happen at the same time, with prayer for Cuba's leadership to change now, for the Mexican president to be removed and for a great new conservative leader who looks like Antonio Banderas to rise in Mexico with the cartel dealt with, and three major leaders seen.
quote: this man that I saw looks like Antonio Banderas
falsify_match: A conservative Mexican leader of that description taking office.
falsify_miss: None. Giving a physical likeness is unusual for him and makes it recognisable.

claim_text: Jewish communities around the United States and the world are uprooted and taken back to Israel, which the Lord says is biblical, and he says they are not worried about the news because the true watchmen warn beforehand while false prophets give a sugar-coated version.
quote: I saw them being uprooted and taken back to Israel
falsify_match: A large emigration of American Jews to Israel.
falsify_miss: None. Aliyah from America has run in the low thousands a year for decades.

claim_text: Angels bear them up, they are about to see things they never thought they would see, and the great shaking to awaken comes even in America in the days ahead so that the church wakes out of its slumber, though they are not afraid because the Lord blesses his people with peace.
quote: the great shaking to awaken even in America
falsify_match: A national crisis followed by a surge in church attendance.
falsify_miss: Neither. Shaking to awaken has no threshold attached anywhere in the corpus.

claim_text: He says they have entered darker days and that he told people of authority that day what he saw concerning Cuba and the smuggling in certain towns on the border, and believes they now have enough information that it will be heard in the news one day.
quote: I told people of authority today about what I saw concerning Cuba
falsify_match: A disclosure matching what he says he passed on.
falsify_miss: None. He does not say who the people of authority are.

claim_text: He says he is in Cuba in the spirit praying over all that is going on there, and can see the mountains and the things in them.
quote: I'm in Cuba right now and I'm praying over all that's going on
falsify_match: Something found in the Cuban mountains.
falsify_miss: None found. The mountains recur across the bunker and briefcase material.
